name: shadcn/ui CLI Builder
summary: Web builder that generates one shadcn CLI command to install any selection of shadcn/ui components.
description: A browser tool that lists the shadcn/ui component catalog — accordion, alert, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, button, calendar, card, carousel, chart, dialog, drawer, dropdown menu, table, sidebar, tooltip and more — and builds a `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add` command for the components you pick, ready to copy into a project. The entry URL redirects to shadcn-cli-builder.vercel.app.
contains: checklist of 63 shadcn/ui components to install
generates a pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add command
select any set of components, then copy one command
includes newer shadcn components such as Bubble, Marker and Questionnaire
